```python
def _execute(cfg):
    policy = _build_policy(cfg['policy'])
    sch = StagedPIFOScheduler(policy, cfg['banks'], cfg['load_balancers'], cfg['fifo_bytes'], cfg['pifo_bytes'], cfg['refill_batch'], cfg['sample_period'], cfg['borders'])
    log = []
    app = log.append
    period = cfg['sample_period']
    saves = {}
    events = cfg['events']
    for i, cmd in enumerate(events):
        kind = cmd[0]
        if kind == 'enqueue':
            pkt = Pkt(cmd[1], cmd[2], cmd[3], cmd[4])
            rank, l, r, q, ok = sch.enqueue(pkt, i)
            app([i, 'enqueue', cmd[1], rank, l, r, q, ok])
            if ok and sch.a == period:
                X, H = sch.sample()
                app([i, 'sample', X, H])
        elif kind == 'dequeue':
            for _ in range(cmd[1]):
                row = sch.service()
                app([i, 'dequeue', row[0], row[1], row[2], row[3], row[4], row[5], row[6]])
        elif kind == 'sample':
            X, H = sch.sample()
            app([i, 'sample', X, H])
        elif kind == 'repartition':
            nR = sch.repartition(cmd[1])
            app([i, 'repartition', nR])
        elif kind == 'cancel':
            stage, bank, lag = sch.cancel(cmd[1])
            app([i, 'cancel', cmd[1], stage, bank, lag])
        elif kind == 'inspect':
            app([i, 'inspect', cmd[1], sch.inspect(cmd[1])])
        elif kind == 'weight':
            policy.set_weight(cmd[1], cmd[2])
            app([i, 'weight', cmd[1], cmd[2]])
        elif kind == 'save':
            saves[cmd[1]] = sch.checkpoint()
            app([i, 'save', cmd[1]])
        elif kind == 'restore':
            name = cmd[1]
            ck = saves.get(name)
            if ck is None: raise ValueError('restore of unsaved slot')
            sch.restore(ck)
            app([i, 'restore', name])
        else:
            raise ValueError('unknown command')
    return {'log': log, 'state': sch.certificate()}
```
